source_of_truth: Operator diagnosis from the Grok/QuantRE onboarding failure, repeated budget/iteration decision friction, role-assignment friction, config/setup sprawl, skill-use friction, and concurrent plan-edit drift during an active DontPanic run: new interactive agents need a machine-level operating brief, new repos need non-clobbering repo onboarding, available worker executors need simple role assignment, all configuration surfaces need one inventory/setup cockpit, valuable skills need safe invocation rubrics, active runs need plan-drift reconciliation, and all surfaces must be generated from one source of truth so manifest, CLI commands, executor registry, config homes, repo instructions, roles, setup status, active plan context, skill recommendations, and operational next-action guidance cannot drift apart.

user_journeys.name: New interactive agent operates DontPanic
user_journeys.description: An interactive agent with shell access runs `dontpanic agent brief`, understands it is an operator, validates the machine with `doctor --agent`, and starts the workflow with `orchestrate`.
acceptance_signals: Brief comes from generated source-of-truth data
Brief distinguishes operator from worker executor
Doctor prints registered worker executors
Orchestrate gateway points to the correct workflow

user_journeys.name: New repo onboards DontPanic
user_journeys.description: A human or interactive agent registers a repo with `projects add --onboard`, sees non-clobbering AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md updates, validates with `doctor --project`, and dispatches via `orchestrate`.
acceptance_signals: AGENTS.md content outside markers is unchanged
Managed block has current generator hash
CLAUDE.md pointer is present or intentionally skipped
Project doctor reports current onboarding state

user_journeys.name: Unsupported agent avoids worker misconfiguration
user_journeys.description: Grok, Gemini, or another unsupported interactive agent reads the generated brief and does not configure itself as a dispatch worker unless a real executor exists.
acceptance_signals: Unsupported agent names do not appear in worker executor list
Unknown roles.* values fail doctor validation
Grok-Builder is rejected unless AGENT_REGISTRY contains it
Docs explain how a future worker executor would be added

user_journeys.name: Operator assigns worker roles without hand-editing JSON
user_journeys.description: A human or interactive agent asks to use an available worker executor for a role, sees global versus project scope, previews the write, and assigns the role through CLI or dashboard-safe command data.
acceptance_signals: Available executors come from AGENT_REGISTRY
Current role output includes source layer
Project role writes do not mutate global config
Dashboard state can render role pickers safely

user_journeys.name: Operator resolves budget and iteration blockers without log archaeology
user_journeys.description: A human or interactive agent sees a budget, cooldown, admission, no-progress, max_iterations blocker, or signed_off/pre_merge finalization gap and receives a short decision set with recommended action, alternatives, exact commands where safe, and tradeoffs.
acceptance_signals: Cooldown guidance includes wait-until plus redispatch command
Budget ceiling guidance includes safer wait path and explicit raise path
Iteration guidance states remaining max_iterations
Signed_off plus cleared pre_merge can finalize a feature without dispatching workers
Dashboard and CLI render the same action choices

user_journeys.name: Operator assesses and updates DontPanic configuration from one cockpit
user_journeys.description: A human or interactive agent asks what needs setup or updating before orchestrating plans and receives a complete grouped inventory with current status, safe commands, human-required setup, optional integration labeling, and dashboard cards.
acceptance_signals: Inventory covers core, optional, and secret/auth surfaces
Safe edits emit exact commands
Secrets are never printed
Dashboard Settings/Setup cards use the same inventory data

user_journeys.name: Operator gets valuable skills recommended without manual prompting
user_journeys.description: A human or interactive agent starts or reviews a plan and DontPanic identifies relevant skills, explains whether each can be auto-run, should be suggested, is blocked by missing inputs, or requires approval, and surfaces the same safe choices in CLI and dashboard.
acceptance_signals: Skills without invocation metadata are never auto-run
Read-only bounded skills auto-run only when required inputs and allowlisted commands are present
Mutating, credentialed, networked, paid, external-write, or indefinite-loop skills require approval or are suggested
Allowlist state and missing rubrics are visible to doctor/config inventory
Contradictory risk signals are downgraded by deterministic precedence rules
CLI and dashboard render the same SkillAction recommendations

user_journeys.name: Concurrent interactive agents change a plan during a run
user_journeys.description: One interactive agent or human edits the plan while another agent-driven DontPanic run is active. DontPanic detects the drift, classifies the impact, refreshes or pauses before spending more budget, and shows one reconciliation action.
acceptance_signals: Plan fingerprint is captured at run start
Changed acceptance/gates/roles/loop caps pause before next paid call
Additive decision-log edits can reconcile without stopping
Dashboard and CLI show one concise drift action

non_goals: No rewrite of historical Jarvis references outside touched onboarding docs
completion_test: All eleven features pass with tests and docs. A fixture unsupported agent sees itself as operator-only, a fixture repo receives current managed onboarding blocks without clobbering existing content, available worker executors can be assigned to roles from CLI/dashboard-safe state without hand-editing JSON, doctor flags unknown roles.*, config-home reconciliation has a non-conflicting migration path, every core configuration surface is visible in a safe inventory/setup cockpit, budget/iteration blockers render clear action choices in CLI and dashboard, signed_off plus cleared pre_merge finalizes a feature without paid worker dispatch, valuable skills are recommended or gated by safe invocation rubrics in CLI and dashboard, active-run plan edits are detected and reconciled before stale-context paid calls, and dashboard serve refuses duplicate live servers.
